inlines.v: DISREGARD, noun [dis and regard.] Neglect; omission of notice; slight; implying indifference or some degree of contempt; as, to pass one with disregard DISREGARD, verb transitive To omit to take notice of; to neglect to observe; to slight as unworthy of regard or notice. Studious of good, man disregarded fame. We are never to disregard the wants of the poor, nor the admonitions of conscience.
